items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: That was T.O. The Raza Teo. That's the guy.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear the... It's a good band though. Yeah. The T.O.s much? On the clarinet?

That's right. That's, that's where the clarinet come in. That was T.O. The Raza Teo. That's the guy. Couldn't call with the old friend of them. That's right. Then they had a guy that played the guitar. He's an old timer. I don't know. And I can't recall his name. I don't know.
Is he here in town? Huh? Is he here in town now? The guitar player.
